evidence.note: danglingStubShape writes shapeSkipReason none exactly when classified is true and a skip reason otherwise; classified-true with a skip payload is never constructed there.

git-worktree discovery writes classified from parentRepo presence with shapeSkipReason always none, so unclassified-with-none is legal and skip presence is not a restatement of !classified. Every classified-true producer (head-install/fallow/scoped-temp/vitest and exact dangling stubs) still writes skip none.
